label: Protect the squad
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She expects the squad kept out of avoidable harm: no wounded soldier sent out, no ally left to fall.

label: No harm to civilians
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She expects no civilian to be hurt on the commander's orders.

label: Meet the quota
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She expects the unit to deliver what the corporation asked for, on time.

label: Obey oversight
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She expects the commander to follow the corporation's directives, even the ones nobody likes.

label: Keep her close
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She expects to be kept in sight: no leaving her behind, no one else at the commander's side.

label: No one else
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She expects no romance with anyone else in the squad.
